audit_scope: saved request bytes only; no inference and no rerun
candidate_rendering: JSON array of five compact server-issued descriptors with id, family, intent, meaning, optional measures/group_by, and result_kind
instruction_bias_evidence: DYNAMIC_TYPED_PLAN is the first enum and receives an explicit positive selection instruction; registered operations receive only the generic choose-best instruction.
contract_defect: The selector contract puts DYNAMIC_TYPED_PLAN first and explains it explicitly while not stating the symmetric registered-operation preference. The selector itself is already a flat one-field constrained task; the 12-field nested, 512-token failure belongs to the secondary dynamic-plan request, not this selector.
architectural_disposition: audit closed; generative operation selection remains architecturally superseded
